headline: July 4th events threatened by heat wave. And, Russia strikes on Ukraine's capital
context: July 4th events for America's milestone birthday are being threatened by a brutal heat wave. And, Russia has struck Ukraine's capital, killing several people in what it calls retaliatory attacks.
